lead_summary.zh: 川普抵深圳晤習普；台股漲102點守4萬
lead_summary.en: Xi greets Trump in Shenzhen; TAIEX up 102, holds 40K

title.zh: 川普抵深圳習近平親迎　美中俄週四會談
title.en: Xi greets Trump in Shenzhen before three-way talks

body.zh: 美國總統川普 18 日抵達廣東深圳出席亞太經合會（APEC），中國國家主席習近平罕見親赴機場停機坪迎接並與他擁抱；俄羅斯總統普丁同日抵達，並先與習近平會面。三人當晚在 APEC 晚宴同框合影，這是川普與普丁自 2025 年 8 月以來首度見面，三方閉門會談定於 19 日舉行，北京形容將就維護世界和平與大國關係戰略穩定深入交流。川普表示會談將觸及結束俄烏戰爭，並稱不會主動提台灣議題；普丁則批評制裁、關稅與出口管制已不合時宜，習近平向企業領袖承諾降關稅、擴大市場開放。
body.en: US President Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen, Guangdong, on the 18th for the APEC summit, and Chinese President Xi Jinping broke with protocol to greet him on the tarmac with a hug; Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived the same day and met Xi first. The three posed together at the APEC gala dinner, Trump and Putin's first encounter since August 2025, and closed-door trilateral talks are set for the 19th, which Beijing said would cover world peace and strategic stability among major powers. Trump said the talks would address ending the war in Ukraine and that he would not raise Taiwan himself; Putin said sanctions, tariffs and export curbs had outlived their usefulness, while Xi pledged tariff cuts and wider market access to business leaders.

title.zh: 美軍打擊格什姆島　伊朗襲科威特巴林
title.en: US hits Qeshm; Iran targets Kuwait and Bahrain

body.zh: 美軍 17 日打擊荷莫茲海峽格什姆島上的伊朗軍事目標，伊朗軍方 18 日稱以無人機攻擊科威特阿里薩勒姆空軍基地的愛國者防空系統及發射平台，巴林也表示其防空系統攔截了伊朗攻擊，目前未見傷亡報告。科威特外交部譴責這是「危險的升級」，伊朗陸軍司令哈塔米則警告，美方若再出手將遭到更具破壞性的回應。海峽航運同樣受創：阿聯國營石油公司 ADNOC 旗下一艘油輪 17 日晚遭不明投射物擊中，1 人失蹤、11 人受傷，另一艘巴拿馬籍液化石油氣船連兩天遇襲後起火漂流，1 名印度籍船員失蹤。
body.en: US forces struck Iranian military targets on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on the 17th, and Iran's army said on the 18th that its drones hit Patriot air-defence systems and launch platforms at Kuwait's Ali Al-Salem Air Base, while Bahrain said its air defences intercepted Iranian attacks; no casualties were reported. Kuwait's foreign ministry condemned a dangerous escalation, and Iranian army chief Amir Hatami warned any new US attack would bring a more devastating response. Shipping was also hit: an ADNOC-managed tanker was struck by an unknown projectile on the evening of the 17th, leaving one crew member missing and 11 injured, and a Panama-flagged LPG carrier attacked two days running was left burning and adrift with one Indian seafarer missing.

title.zh: 俄軍空襲奧德薩舊城　至少4死13傷
title.en: Russian strikes on Odesa kill at least four

body.zh: 半島電視台報導，烏軍打擊刻赤大橋隔天，俄軍空襲烏克蘭多地造成至少 5 人死亡，其中南部港市奧德薩 4 死 13 傷，3 枚飛彈落在歷史城區，其中一處位於聯合國教科文組織保護範圍。澤倫斯基指這是「蓄意的殘暴攻擊」，並稱俄軍在救援與警察抵達後再度轟炸；烏克蘭能源部表示，俄軍自 9 月以來已對能源設施發動逾千次攻擊，過去一天有 8 個州停電。歐盟執委會同日提議向烏克蘭提供 450 億歐元貸款，美烏代表團另預計 19 日在柏林展開會談。
body.en: Al Jazeera reported that a day after Ukraine's strike on the Kerch Bridge, Russian air attacks across Ukraine killed at least five people, including four killed and 13 wounded in the southern port of Odesa, where three strikes hit the historic centre, one in a UNESCO-protected area. President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack brutal and deliberate, saying Russia struck again after rescuers and police had arrived; Ukraine's energy ministry said Russia has launched more than 1,000 attacks on energy facilities since September, with outages in eight regions over the past day. The European Commission proposed a 45 billion euro loan to Ukraine the same day, and US and Ukrainian delegations were due to begin talks in Berlin on the 19th.

title.zh: 以國會66比52選新議長　艾森柯特陣營勝
title.en: Knesset elects Eisenkot ally Kahana as speaker

body.zh: 以色列國會 17 日在納坦雅胡陣營杯葛拖延約 6 小時後，以 66 票對 52 票選出艾森柯特所屬 Yashar 黨的卡哈納出任議長，取代聯合黨的歐哈納，擊敗聯合黨提名的卡茨。支持卡哈納的 6 個政黨合計握有 120 席中的 67 席，包括兩個阿拉伯政黨；卡哈納承諾當「所有人的議長」，艾森柯特說國會將重新發揮監督功能。聯合黨及其盟友則痛批這次投票是「永遠的恥辱」；目前雙方陣營都未湊足組閣所需的 61 席，艾森柯特仍與聯合黨商談組成團結政府的可能性。
body.en: After a roughly six-hour filibuster by Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc, Israel's Knesset voted 66-52 on the 17th to elect Matan Kahana of Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party as speaker, replacing Likud's Amir Ohana and defeating Likud nominee Ofir Katz. The six parties backing Kahana, including two Arab parties, hold 67 of the 120 seats; Kahana pledged to be the speaker for all, and Eisenkot said the Knesset would again serve as an effective oversight body. Likud and its allies called the vote an eternal disgrace; neither camp yet has the 61 seats needed to govern, and Eisenkot is still negotiating with Likud over a possible unity government.

title.zh: 衣索比亞厄利垂亞　邊境大舉集結兵力
title.en: Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops on border

body.zh: 路透引述衝突監測機構 ACLED、國際危機組織及提格雷地區武裝人士報導，衣索比亞與厄利垂亞已在共同邊境集結兵力，雙方部隊進入彼此打擊範圍，引發兩國可能爆發全面戰爭的憂慮。ACLED 指出，爭議城鎮巴德梅自上週起出現砲擊與武裝衝突，但也有親衣索比亞民兵人士否認交火，路透無法獨立證實。厄利垂亞新聞部長稱衣國執政黨的說法是「宣傳」，並否認派兵進入衣索比亞；衣索比亞政府則未立即回應，該國先前指控厄軍 10 月初進入提格雷支援叛軍。
body.en: Reuters, citing conflict monitor ACLED, the International Crisis Group and people tied to militias in Tigray, reported that Ethiopia and Eritrea have massed forces along their shared border, bringing the armies within striking distance and raising fears of outright war. ACLED said artillery fire and clashes have occurred around the disputed town of Badme since last week, though a person close to a pro-Ethiopian militia denied fighting and Reuters could not independently confirm it. Eritrea's information minister dismissed Ethiopian ruling-party claims as propaganda and denies entering Ethiopia, while Ethiopia's government did not immediately respond; it has previously accused Eritrean forces of entering Tigray in early October to back rebels.

title.en: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share

body.zh: 據 TechCrunch 等媒體引述消息人士報導，AI 公司 Anthropic 首次公開發行每股訂價 83 美元，高於原先 70 至 78 美元的區間，以完全稀釋股數計算估值約 1.5 兆美元，遠高於 5 月私募輪的 9,650 億美元。該公司將於 19 日在那斯達克掛牌，代號 ANT；另有多家大型科技公司同意透過私募認購 260 億美元無投票權股份。公司方面尚未正式證實訂價。
body.en: AI company Anthropic has priced its initial public offering at US$83 a share, above the initial range of US$70 to US$78, according to TechCrunch and other outlets citing sources, valuing it at about US$1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis, well above the US$965 billion of its May private round. The shares are due to start trading on Nasdaq on the 19th under the ticker ANT, and a group of major tech companies agreed to buy US$26 billion of non-voting shares in a concurrent private placement. The company had not officially confirmed the price.

title.zh: Fed紀要：近全員預期12月升息
title.en: Fed minutes: nearly all see December hike

body.zh: 美國聯準會 18 日公布 10 月 27 至 28 日會議紀要，顯示幾乎所有官員預期 12 月將升息 1 碼，有兩位官員提出升息 2 碼的可能，紀要也暗示 2027 年初可能進一步升息。聯準會 10 月將關鍵利率維持在 3.9%，理事庫克與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克投下反對票、主張升息；多數決策官員擔心即使油價回落、關稅與 AI 基礎建設效應淡化，通膨仍可能居高不下。CME FedWatch 顯示市場對 12 月升息的機率押注近 95%，美元升至 19 個月高點。
body.en: Minutes of the Federal Reserve's October 27-28 meeting, released on the 18th, showed nearly all officials expect a quarter-point hike in December, with two raising the possibility of a half-point move, and pointed to further increases likely in early 2027. The Fed held its key rate at 3.9% in October, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissenting in favour of a hike, and a vast majority worried inflation could persist even as gasoline prices ease and the effects of tariffs and the AI infrastructure build-out fade. CME FedWatch showed markets pricing nearly a 95% chance of a December hike, and the dollar rose to a 19-month high.

title.zh: 英國10月通膨升至3.6%　連四月走高
title.en: UK inflation climbs to 3.6% in October

body.zh: 英國國家統計局 18 日公布，10 月消費者物價指數年增 3.6%，為 2025 年 10 月以來最高，且連續第四個月上升。車用燃料價格年漲 33.2%，柴油每公升平均 199.5 便士，創 1996 年有紀錄以來新高；菸酒漲幅擴大至 4.5%，食品漲幅則放緩至 0.9%。英國央行已將基準利率升至 4%，其貨幣政策報告指出通膨明年年中可能升至 5% 左右。
body.en: The Office for National Statistics said on the 18th that UK consumer prices rose 3.6% in the year to October, the highest since October 2025 and a fourth straight monthly increase. Motor fuel prices were up 33.2% year on year, with diesel averaging 199.5p a litre, the highest since records began in 1996, alcohol and tobacco inflation quickened to 4.5%, and food inflation eased to 0.9%. The Bank of England has already raised its base rate to 4%, and its Monetary Policy Report said inflation could reach about 5% by the middle of next year.

title.zh: 輝達擴大供應鏈合作　點名台積電鴻海等台廠
title.en: Nvidia expands supply deals with Taiwan firms

body.zh: 輝達 17 日宣布擴大與供應鏈夥伴合作，增加載板、先進封裝、晶圓製造與代工產能，以支援現有及下一代加速運算平台，台積電、鴻海、景碩與日月光旗下矽品等台廠入列。景碩桃園廠供應輝達的 ABF 載板產能將擴增逾 3.5 倍，新產能目標 2028 年第三季到位；輝達並將以多年期協議提供數十億美元資金，協助矽品在 2029 年中前於台灣擴建先進封裝產能。鴻海董事長劉揚偉表示，將以亞洲、北美與歐洲的生產網絡支援新一代 AI 基礎設施量產。
body.en: Nvidia announced on the 17th that it is expanding partnerships with suppliers to add capacity in substrates, advanced packaging, wafer manufacturing and contract assembly for its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms, naming Taiwan's TSMC, Hon Hai, Kinsus and ASE unit SPIL among them. Kinsus will lift ABF substrate capacity for Nvidia at its Taoyuan plant more than 3.5-fold, with the new capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028, and Nvidia will provide billions of dollars under a multi-year deal to help SPIL expand advanced packaging in Taiwan by mid-2029. Hon Hai chairman Young Liu said the group would use its production network across Asia, North America and Europe to support the ramp-up of next-generation AI infrastructure.

title.zh: 輝達財報亮眼股價反跌　接班疑慮壓抑

body.zh: 輝達公布季營收倍增至逾 1,150 億美元、淨利 653 億美元，並將下一財年營收成長預估由 70% 上調至 75%，盤後一度上漲近 5%，但 18 日正常交易終場下跌 2.9% 收 150.96 美元，成交量約為三個月均量的兩倍多。市場焦點轉向領導階層不確定性與中國相關監管審查：董事會拒絕讓辭職的前執行長黃仁勳回任，黃仁勳則已同意 12 月 1 日與美國國會議員會面討論晶片與國安議題；代理執行長柯蕾絲表示公司運作「一切如常」。
body.en: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue that doubled to more than US$115 billion and net profit of US$65.3 billion, and raised its forecast for next fiscal year's revenue growth to 75% from 70%, briefly gaining nearly 5% after hours, but the stock closed down 2.9% at US$150.96 in regular trading on the 18th on volume more than double its three-month average. Attention shifted to leadership uncertainty and China-related regulatory scrutiny: the board has declined to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned and has agreed to meet US lawmakers on December 1 about chips and national security, while interim CEO Colette Kress said it was business as usual.

headline.zh: 結算日震盪1,677點　台股漲102點守4萬
headline.en: TAIEX gains 102, holds 40,000 after wild settlement day

body.zh: 加權指數 18 日受輝達財報激勵跳空開高，以 40,720.09 點開出、一度漲至 40,938.20 點，隨後在台指期結算、黃仁勳去留爭議與停損賣壓下翻黑，最低跌破 4 萬點至 39,260.99 點，盤中震盪 1,677 點，尾盤拉回，終場上漲 102.80 點、收 40,194.91 點，漲幅 0.26%，成交值 1 兆 306.85 億元；上市 499 家上漲、533 家下跌、81 家持平，櫃買指數漲 0.94 點（0.31%）收 307.55 點。權值股中，台積電小漲 5 元收 2,175 元，聯發科漲 100 元至 3,940 元（2.60%），鴻海漲 2 元至 221 元；輝達宣布擴大與台廠合作，景碩、欣興等載板股與京元電走強，金融類股則重挫 3.22%。外資賣超 765.63 億元，新台幣盤中貶破 33 元，媒體指出外資提款與匯率偏弱仍是壓力來源。
body.en: The TAIEX gapped higher on the 18th after Nvidia's results, opening at 40,720.09 and reaching 40,938.20 before turning lower amid futures settlement, the dispute over Jensen Huang's future and stop-loss selling, briefly falling below 40,000 to 39,260.99 in a 1,677-point intraday swing; it recovered late to close up 102.80 points or 0.26% at 40,194.91 on turnover of NT$1.03 trillion, with 499 listed stocks up, 533 down and 81 unchanged, while the TPEx index rose 0.94 points (0.31%) to 307.55. Among heavyweights, TSMC edged up NT$5 to NT$2,175, MediaTek gained NT$100 to NT$3,940 (2.60%) and Hon Hai rose NT$2 to NT$221; substrate makers Kinsus and Unimicron and tester KYEC rallied after Nvidia expanded supply deals with Taiwan firms, while financials slumped 3.22%. Foreign investors sold a net NT$76.563 billion and the NT dollar weakened past 33 per US dollar intraday, which media cited as continuing sources of pressure.

flows_note.zh: 外資連續第三個交易日賣超，三日合計約 1,848 億元；投信則逆勢買超。外資台指期淨空單增至 99,438 口。
flows_note.en: Foreign investors were net sellers for a third straight session, about NT$184.8 billion in total, while investment trusts were net buyers; foreign net short TAIEX futures rose to 99,438 contracts.

headline.zh: 美股：道瓊跌561點　那指費半收紅
headline.en: US close, Nov 18: Dow falls 561; Nasdaq, SOX up

body.zh: 週三（18 日）美股漲跌互見，道瓊跌 561.25 點（1.11%）收 50,198.17 點，標普 500 跌 0.23% 收 7,323.63 點、連五個交易日下跌並跌破 200 日均線，那指則漲 0.42% 收 24,429.88 點，費城半導體指數小漲 0.10% 收 9,652.80 點，台積電 ADR 漲 0.38% 收 361.07 美元。聯準會紀要顯示幾乎所有官員預期進一步升息，美元升至 19 個月高點；聯合健康重挫 10.21%、Humana 跌約 13%，因政府提議擴大聯邦醫療保險優勢計畫（Medicare Advantage）稽核，拖累道瓊。輝達財報後收跌 2.9%，亞馬遜則因市場關注其對 Anthropic 的投資而上漲 3.82%。
body.en: US stocks were mixed on Wednesday, November 18: the Dow fell 561.25 points (1.11%) to 50,198.17 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.23% to 7,323.63, a fifth straight decline that took it below its 200-day moving average, while the Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24,429.88, the SOX edged up 0.10% to 9,652.80 and the TSMC ADR gained 0.38% to US$361.07. Fed minutes showed nearly all officials expect further hikes, lifting the dollar to a 19-month high; UnitedHealth sank 10.21% and Humana about 13% on a proposal to expand Medicare Advantage audits, weighing on the Dow. Nvidia closed down 2.9% after its results, while Amazon rose 3.82% as attention turned to its stake in Anthropic.
